messages: #p203# of #m10001000# seems to want to deliver good news to #p202#.
#p203# of #m10001000# asked me to deliver the freshly polished #b#t4031117##k to #b#p202##k. She seems a bit cautious about handing it over herself.

I delivered the #t4031117# to #p202# of #m10001000#, and he was extremely surprised yet overjoyed. Seeing his eyes sparkle like that, it looks as though he might set off on an adventure again right this moment! At any rate, I should report all of this back to #p203#.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k
name: Memories of Youth
